component.name: RommDeck
component.summary: RomM client for the Steam Deck

description.p: RommDeck connects your Steam Deck to your RomM server. It downloads games and BIOS files into the folders your emulators actually read, and keeps their saves and save states in sync with RomM, in the background, whether the app is open or not.

It works with RetroDECK, EmuDeck and whatever emulators you installed yourself, not just RetroArch. Its 40-odd built-in profiles, from PS1 to Switch, sync each save in the format the emulator reads: PS2 memory cards, GameCube GCI folders, Wii NAND saves, Switch user saves.

ul.li: Browse your RomM library and download games straight to the Deck, SD card included
Saves in the same shape Argosy and RommPS use, so they carry over between devices
Conflicts settled and older versions restored from the app or its web UI
Controller first, with touch and mouse, in Game Mode and Desktop Mode
Signed releases: the background service checks the signature before it updates itself

description.p: The first launch installs RomM Sync, its background service, as a systemd user service, so syncing carries on after the window closes. It needs a RomM server of your own, 5.2.0 or newer. Games not included.

screenshot.caption: The library on the Steam Deck

description.p: The first release: the RomM library, save and state sync, BIOS and firmware, for RetroDECK, EmuDeck and standalone emulators.
